content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail: Start digital

Traditional platforms like Gumroad and PayPal impose high fees and strict regulations that can stifle your ability to sell digital products. For instance, Gumroad charges 10% on every sale, while NOWPayments only takes 0.5%. This significant difference means that with just 100 sales of a $97 product per month, you could retain an additional $921. This architecture allows you to maintain complete control over your revenue without the burden of platform dependency, offering true financial sovereignty.
What You Need Before You Deploy

To get started, you will need a few essential components: a domain name for your store, hosting through platforms like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, and a backend solution using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Additionally, you'll need a storage solution for your product files, such as Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, and an account with NOWPayments for processing cryptocurrency transactions. Make sure to have your digital products ready, whether they are ebooks, courses, templates, or plugins, to upload once your infrastructure is in place.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Begin by deploying your chosen infrastructure stack, such as the Sovereign Starter Stack or Edge Commerce Stack. Load your products, configure your payment gateway with NOWPayments for automatic crypto payment processing, and ensure your delivery pipeline is functional. Use Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to automate the delivery of your digital goods. Test the entire workflow to guarantee that customers receive their products immediately after payment confirmation. This approach ensures a seamless purchasing experience for your customers.
Reduce your transaction fees from 10% to 0.5% with NOWPayments.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your store is set up, it's time to go live. Share your store link and start marketing your digital products across social media and other channels. Monitor your transaction dashboard closely as your first customers begin to make purchases. When an order is placed, the NOWPayments integration will automatically verify the payment and trigger the delivery of the product via your chosen method. This process not only saves time but also builds trust with your customers who receive their products without delay.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Once your store is operational, consider scaling your offerings. Expand your product range, optimize your marketing strategies, and leverage the Complete Builder Kit ($197) to access additional blueprints and templates that enhance your store's functionality. Continuing to monitor performance metrics will help you make informed decisions about scaling. Ensure that your backend can handle increased traffic and transactions efficiently. This proactive approach will allow you to grow sustainably while maintaining full control over your infrastructure.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

The fastest path to your first sovereign digital product sale is a three-step process. First, create a NOWPayments account — configure your wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as starting points, generate your API key, and set the webhook endpoint URL. Second, choose your stack: Stack 01 uses GitHub Pages plus Google Apps Script and takes most creators four to six hours following the Sovereign Blueprint at $47; Stack 02 uses Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase and is deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours with the Edge Commerce Stack at $197. Third, upload your product files, set your prices in USD, and run a complete mainnet test transaction before promoting.
Maintain total ownership and control over your digital products.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you're looking to sell digital downloads without platform fees, explore the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which provides comprehensive tools and templates to establish your store. With this kit, you can effectively manage sales without relying on traditional payment processors. Check out our shop at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html for more information.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.

The most effective way is to deploy a sovereign digital commerce infrastructure. Using NOWPayments, you can process payments with minimal fees, retaining more of your profits.

Absolutely. By setting up your own digital store using COREMERCH's stacks, you gain full control over your sales without incurring the fees associated with platforms like Gumroad.
What cryptocurrencies can I accept?
NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, allowing you to accept various forms of digital currency easily. Choose optimal networks like BSC, Solana, or TRON for low transaction fees.

With the Sovereign Starter Stack or Edge Commerce Stack, you can have your store live within 48 hours, ready to start processing transactions and delivering your digital products.
